title: finance-dashboard
text:
Reviewed. Here is what I found.
Health: good bones

Proper repo. Clerk clerkMiddleware gates every non-static path including /api/, so nothing is reachable unauthenticated. The userId invariant from CLAUDE.md is honored the right way: route handlers don't touch auth themselves, they call into lib/data/queries.ts and lib/data/tax-records.ts, which resolve the Clerk session server-side (getCurrentUserId() / requireUserId()) and pass userid into Convex. The schema backs it: every table except fincategories carries userid with a byuserand index. 10 of 11 exported functions in tax-records.ts follow the pattern.
One real security bug

deleteForeignIncome has no ownership check. Any signed-in user can delete any other user's foreign income record.

The chain, all three links missing a check:
app/api/tax/foreign-income/route.ts:24 takes id straight from the query string.
lib/data/tax-records.ts:156 is the only exported function in that file that never calls requireUserId(). It forwards the raw id.
convex/tax.ts:221 is handler: async (ctx, { id }) => { await ctx.db.delete(id) }. No user filter, no existence check, no return of what was deleted.

Failure scenario: user A signed in, DELETE /api/tax/foreign-income?id=. Convex document ids are opaque but not secret; they are handed to the browser by listForeignIncome for every row a user owns, so they leak naturally through normal use and are visible in devtools. Nothing about A's session is consulted. Returns { ok: true }.

The fix is small and mirrors the pattern already used everywhere else: pass userId down, and in the mutation ctx.db.get(id) first, compare doc.user_id, throw if it does not match.

I scanned all Convex mutations and actions for the same shape. Two others take no userId, both benign: dashboard.ts:ensureCategory and migration.ts:upsertCategoriesBatch write to fincategories, which is deliberately global (no userid column in the schema). deleteForeignIncome is the only one touching a per-user table.
Structural gaps
No tests, no CI. Zero test files, no vitest/jest/playwright config, no .github/. On an app that computes Swiss tax estimates, lib/tax/ is exactly the code that most wants a test suite, and it has none. There is also no typecheck script; next build is the only gate.
Uncommitted work sitting on main. The tax prep checklist (app/tax/checklist/, components/tax/tax-prep-checklist-client.tsx, lib/tax/prep-checklist.ts) plus edits to tax-dashboard-client.tsx and convex/lib/rules.ts. Every other feature here went through a PR branch. This one didn't.
Rules drift. convex/lib/rules.ts gained 8 Swiss dining merchants; the Python app/categorize/rules.yaml has a separate 89-line staged rewrite. The two sides CLAUDE.md says to keep in sync are diverging.
Minor: @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu and @radix-ui/react-select are pinned to "latest" while all 25 sibling Radix packages are exact-pinned. [v0] scaffolding prefixes still in production error logs.
Suggested order
Fix the deleteForeignIncome authorization hole. Small, isolated, three files.
Branch the checklist work off main and open a PR, per your / convention.
Reconcile the two rules files.
Then talk about a test harness for lib/tax/.

Want me to do 1? I'd add the ownership check plus a regression test, on a fix/foreign-income-ownership-check branch. Convex changed, so per your runbook that means npx convex dev --once before any Vercel deploy, and I would not deploy production without you saying so.
